notes:
Friend profiles, PS5-style ✿
• Selecting a friend now opens their profile: status, what they're playing, Steam level and hours in the last 2 weeks
• Their recently played games, with hours, last played and trophy progress (Platinum shows when they've 100%'d it)
• Message, View trophies, Steam profile and Remove friend, right on their profile
• View trophies: see a friend's full trophy list for a game, with "You ✓" on the ones you've earned too
• Compare with your games: open any of your games to see how a friend is doing in it
• Back from a profile returns to your friends list
• In the friends list, F / Y still jumps straight to Message
